description: This file defines a SignificantLocationMonitor enum with a static method to monitor significant location changes. It uses CoreLocation to observe location updates and sends JSON-encoded payloads with location data to a gateway, primarily for tracking user location at work.

methods.name: startIfNeeded
methods.description: Starts monitoring significant location changes if the location mode is set to always and authorization is granted. When location updates occur, it encodes the location data into JSON and sends an event through the gateway.
